label: prf:categorical-q-connection-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of the categorical $q$-connection
html: The formula \nabla_q = q^{-1} \nabla + (1 - q^{-1}) \iota_\xi \nabla \circ \varTheta is a fixed R-linear combination of uniquely-determined morphisms. Uniqueness of \nabla up to gauge (uniqueness of categorical connections) extends to \nabla_q through the linear map; the q-deformation does not introduce additional gauge freedom.
heading: Proof
